```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans propose a scheme that would reduce Social Security funding by $1 trillion in payroll taxes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican scheme would reduce the life of Social Security by 14 years.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican scheme would eliminate the guaranteed retirement security provided by Social Security.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican scheme would raise the possibility of massive government bail-outs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Independent analyses suggest the Republican privatization plan would cut guaranteed benefits for young workers by as much as 54 percent.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican scheme would remove the \"security\" from Social Security.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Retirement Savings Plus does not threaten Social Security's guaranteed benefit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Social Security is 65 years old but is not ready to be retired.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"George W. Bush's $2 trillion tax cut, campaign-season spending proposals, support for an unspecified missile defense system, and support for privatizing Social Security constitute an assault on the surplus.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Americans would have to choose between cuts in education and health care or a return to deficit spending if George W. Bush's policies are enacted.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"With fiscal discipline and a commitment to values, it is possible to both save Social Security and allow Americans to create a nest egg without reversing prosperity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```

{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republicans propose a scheme that would siphon $1 trillion in payroll taxes away from the Social Security trust fund.",
